Confirmed independently from the canonical U.4 target and BMS Appendix (A.5)-(A.8), printed pp.82-83, rather than relying on acceptance of KTheoryLowDegrees--U.1.json. The focal map records KTheoryLowDegrees with hits=[] and omits both Layer 10 -> U.4 and Layer 4 -> U.4; the extracted U.4 requires list also lacks them. U.4 explicitly requires the actual class-field-theory inputs in the Bass-Milnor-Serre argument. In (A.7), class-field existence identifies a finite-index idele-class quotient with an abelian Galois group, and (A.6) supplies infinitely many prime representatives in each Frobenius class. For the number-field part of (A.8), let m>=2 and let a primitive m-th root be absent from k. A nonidentity automorphism of k(zeta_m)/k occurs at infinitely many primes away from m by Layer 10; Layer 4 identifies its action as zeta_m -> zeta_m^(N p), hence N p is not 1 modulo m. These are two distinct imported interfaces, with arithmetic Frobenius and the absolute residue norm. Add both as inferred links with canonical endpoint quotations and replace the negative examined entry. Preserve the separate class-field existence/reciprocity input; do not infer function-field (A.9), an effective bound, or SK1 vanishing from Chebotarev alone. The large K-theory packet was not independently decoded/read in this run, so its reported node-level requests and partial/unreviewed status are not certified here. The original source and existing canonical target suffice for the two links. Full production reachability/cycle checks remain an application-time requirement.
